bull_bear.body:
- Indigenous manufacturer of Catalysts, Adsorbents and Ceramic balls in India
- Track record of profitability and consistent financial performance in an industry with significant entry barriers

bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Outstanding Goods & Service tax demand contingent liability — Claims against the company not acknowledged as debts of Rs. 32.46 Lakhs (GST demand, appeal filed May 13, 2024, pending at SGST Appellate Authority) pertaining to ITC availment for FY 2017-18
- Reliance on related-party borrowings from Promoters and Promoter HUFs — Company has taken loans from Promoters and Promoter-group HUFs (e.g. borrowing balances of Rs. 81.10 Lakhs and Rs. 29.20 Lakhs as at 31-Mar-25) creating dependence on related-party funding
- Single manufacturing facility concentration — All manufacturing operations are carried out at one facility in Wadhwan City, Surendranagar, Gujarat, concentrating operational risk at a single location

business.body: Devson Catalyst Limited is an indigenous manufacturer of catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls that are used to improve process efficiency and facilitate removal of impurities from gases and liquids across various industrial applications. Its products are supplied to customers operating in industries such as oil and gas refineries, petrochemicals, steel, fertilizers and other industrial processing sectors, in both domestic and international markets. The Company operates a single manufacturing facility in Gujarat with a total installed capacity of approximately 6,205.00 MT per annum.

internal_operational.risk: Our revenues are concentrated among a limited number of customers, and the loss of one or more such customers, deterioration in their financial condition, or a reduction in their demand for our products could adversely affect our business, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows.

A substantial portion of our revenue from operations is derived from few customers, including large customers in the oil & gas, refining, petrochemical, steel and fertilizer value chains that procure catalysts, adsorbents and ceramic balls for critical process units.
The absence of long-term contracts with our customers exposes us to a significant risk of customer attrition and challenges in relation to production planning.

strategy_growth.risk: Further, given our export presence, demand and collections may also be impacted by developments in overseas markets, including changes in industrial activity, regulatory or trade conditions, currency volatility and international logistics disruptions, which may add to variability in our revenues and cash flows.

Our export business, is dependent on overseas distributors, and any disruption in our engagement with such distributors could adversely affect our revenues and results of operations For our export-related activities, we rely on third-party distributors located outside India to identify potential customers, generate business leads and procure orders on our behalf in overseas markets.
There can be no assurance that our overseas distributors will continue to represent us effectively, maintain customer relationships, or generate a consistent volume of orders in the future.
